subject: Mobile Development
title: The Digital Markets Act
description: One-minute skill: The Digital Markets Act.

hook.text: The EU passed a law that could end app store monopolies in Europe forever.

buildup.text: The Digital Markets Act designates Apple and Google as 'gatekeepers' with special obligations.

discovery.text: Gatekeepers must allow sideloading, third-party app stores, and alternative payment systems.

twist.text: Apple complied with complexity: new fees, terms, and conditions that critics call malicious.

climax.text: The DMA is the most ambitious attempt to regulate app store power in history.

punchline.text: Europe wrote the rules. Now gatekeepers must obey.

quiz.question: What does the Digital Markets Act require?
options: Gatekeepers must allow sideloading and alternative payment
All apps must be free in Europe
Only European companies can make apps
